# DSM — Design System Maker

> A zero-configuration web tool for vibe-coding AI developers.

## What it does
DSM lets developers instantly visualize "best practice" UI design system templates
(colors, typography, spacing, border radius), tweak them visually, and export the
result as AI-friendly formats: a Markdown rules file, JSON design tokens, or
CSS custom properties.

## Who it's for
Vibe Coders and AI Developers who are starting a new project and need a fast way
to establish a consistent visual direction before asking their AI agent to build the UI.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript
- Styling: Vanilla CSS with CSS custom properties
- Package manager: pnpm
- No backend — 100% client-side, works offline

## Core Entities
- Theme: a named design system configuration (colors, typography, spacing, border radius)
- ExportedDesignRules: the generated output artifact (MD/JSON/CSS string, downloaded as a file)

## Key Files
- src/data/templates.ts       — built-in design system templates
- src/types/theme.ts          — TypeScript types for all design tokens
- src/utils/export.ts         — export generation (MD, JSON, CSS)
- docs/data-maps/THEME_DATA_MAP.md — the data contract
